name: Bitpanda Card
summary: Bitpanda Card lets you spend crypto, fiat, or precious metals with real-time conversion. Earn 1-2% cashback in BTC based on BEST/VSN token holdings. MiCAR regulated in Europe.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the Bitpanda Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Bitpanda Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Bitpanda Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
